This is a known minor bug in the Dockerfile, and the app itself is running and responding normally. The health check failure is due to the image not having curl, not because the app is down.

Since the health endpoint is returning 200 when accessed from the host, I'll verify that the app is fully functional. The app is a Streamlit app for SmartPlanAI. I'll confirm that the page content is the SmartPlanAI app and that the process is running properly inside the container.

Also, the container is in an "Up" state, and the app is responding. The installation (following the guide, `make run`) is complete. The unhealthy status is a quirk of the image's health check, not an installation failure — the software is installed and working normally.
